requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "At dawn, the mist outside the sect gate had not yet lifted."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough qi stones?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Brought three pouches, all the best from the back mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The ward cracked again last night, and Elder Qin hasn't slept all night."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Before the words had finished, Mòqí Jìng came racing up from the foot of the mountain."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Gasping for breath, he said that a young woman was lying by the road at the bottom of the mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Bring her up quickly. Ruoshui, go fetch the healing pills."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wan Qi Jing ran into the hall carrying an unconscious young woman on his back; the iron token at his waist was engraved: Qiu Shuang."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "It's not serious, she's just run out of spiritual energy. Feed her one Spirit-Restoring Pill and she'll be fine."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qín wants you at the ward. Wan Qi Senior Brother and I will stay here."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Alright. When Miss Qiú wakes up, come get me right away."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wan Qi Jing scratched his head and turned to run toward the foot of the mountain again."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "解玄 stood at the hall doorway, her sword still sheathed, yet the lamplight dimmed for a moment."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "覃长老, it has been a long time. I have been sent by the Pavilion Lord to collect three tenths of the qi stones."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Three parts? The qi stones were scraped together by the sect with hard work. When did outsiders get to take them?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "The ward has already cracked, so the qi stones are not safe in your hands. I'll come back in three days."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Xiè Xuán let out a cold laugh, turned, and left without looking back."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Three days means three days. I have never broken my word."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder Qín stroked his beard and glanced at Chóu Shuāng, who lay asleep on the couch."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder, let me go and guard the ward. 仇姑娘 has 乐川 to look after her, so I can be spared."}, {"id": 1, "text": "At last came a nod, and a jade talisman was drawn from within the sleeve."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "This is the formation-eye token. Guard it, and you have guarded your Dao."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Yuè Chuān stuffed the medicine pouch into Yún Zhōu's arms and murmured a few more instructions."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "At the mountain gate, 万俟靖 handed me a straw raincoat."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Thank you, Senior Brother 万俟. Please tell 仇姑娘 I'm grateful that she has woken up."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Dan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation-eye token close to his body."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Good that you're awake. You've been unconscious for a whole day, so don't move around carelessly ▼"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Qiu Shuang struggled to sit up and gazed out the window at the cracked sky."}, {"id": 1, "text": "No one noticed that the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal."}]}

translations.1: At dawn, the mist outside the sect gate had not yet lifted.
translations.10: Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qín wants you at the ward. Wan Qi Senior Brother and I will stay here.
translations.11: Alright. When Miss Qiú wakes up, come get me right away.
translations.12: Wan Qi Jing scratched his head and turned to run toward the foot of the mountain again.
translations.13: 解玄 stood at the hall doorway, her sword still sheathed, yet the lamplight dimmed for a moment.
translations.14: 覃长老, it has been a long time. I have been sent by the Pavilion Lord to collect three tenths of the qi stones.
translations.15: Three parts? The qi stones were scraped together by the sect with hard work. When did outsiders get to take them?
translations.16: The ward has already cracked, so the qi stones are not safe in your hands. I'll come back in three days.
translations.17: Xiè Xuán let out a cold laugh, turned, and left without looking back.
translations.18: Three days means three days. I have never broken my word.
translations.19: Elder Qín stroked his beard and glanced at Chóu Shuāng, who lay asleep on the couch.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough qi stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me go and guard the ward. 仇姑娘 has 乐川 to look after her, so I can be spared.
translations.21: At last came a nod, and a jade talisman was drawn from within the sleeve.
translations.22: This is the formation-eye token. Guard it, and you have guarded your Dao.
translations.23: Yuè Chuān stuffed the medicine pouch into Yún Zhōu's arms and murmured a few more instructions.
translations.24: At the mountain gate, 万俟靖 handed me a straw raincoat.
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Brother 万俟. Please tell 仇姑娘 I'm grateful that she has woken up.
translations.26: Dan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation-eye token close to his body.
translations.27: In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: Good that you're awake. You've been unconscious for a whole day, so don't move around carelessly ▼
translations.29: Qiu Shuang struggled to sit up and gazed out the window at the cracked sky.
translations.3: Brought three pouches, all the best from the back mountain.
translations.30: No one noticed that the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal.
translations.4: The ward cracked again last night, and Elder Qin hasn't slept all night.
translations.5: Before the words had finished, Mòqí Jìng came racing up from the foot of the mountain.
translations.6: Gasping for breath, he said that a young woman was lying by the road at the bottom of the mountain.
translations.7: Bring her up quickly. Ruoshui, go fetch the healing pills.
translations.8: Wan Qi Jing ran into the hall carrying an unconscious young woman on his back; the iron token at his waist was engraved: Qiu Shuang.
translations.9: It's not serious, she's just run out of spiritual energy. Feed her one Spirit-Restoring Pill and she'll be fine.
